description.shortText: The hotel robotic assistant is best suited for small and modest B&B accommodations that do not offer a 24-hour concierge service. The robot will act as an on-demand concierge service by offering answers to questions/inquiries from the guests. Anyone may get the information he/she needs from the robotic assistant, whether they have inquiries about F&B recommendations, close-by attractions, or information requests on anything related to the accommodations.
